title: Space launches: which country?
intro: Pick the country for each launch, as recorded on Wikidata.

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Compton Gamma Ray Observatory?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives United States of America as the country of Compton Gamma Ray Observatory (5 April 1991).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Kepler Space Telescope?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives United States of America as the country of Kepler Space Telescope (7 March 2009).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Aryabhata?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives India as the country of Aryabhata (19 April 1975).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Chang'e 3?
choices: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
questions.explain: Wikidata gives China as the country of Chang'e 3 (1 December 2013).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Hayabusa?
choices: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Japan as the country of Hayabusa (9 May 2003).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Chandrayaan-1?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives India as the country of Chandrayaan-1 (22 October 2008).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Tiangong space station?
questions.explain: Wikidata gives China as the country of Tiangong space station (29 April 2021).

questions.prompt: Which country is linked to Harmony?
choices: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
questions.explain: Wikidata gives Italy as the country of Harmony (23 October 2007).
